name: Every non-draft journal entry must have equal, strictly positive total debits and credits reconciled against at least two linked lines

payload.rationale: Every non-draft journal entry must have equal, strictly positive total debits and credits backed by at least two linked JournalLine rows whose debit_amount and credit_amount sums exactly match the header totals.

response.expression: self.total_debit == self.total_credit and self.total_debit > 0 and len(self.lines) >= 2 and sum(map(self.lines, #.debit_amount)) == self.total_debit and sum(map(self.lines, #.credit_amount)) == self.total_credit

payload.subject: accounting.JournalEntry
